title: fix(plugin-detail): a related table in the record preview drawer draws instead of looping on its column cap
body:
Fixes #37212 Clause-②: no Metadata-protocol: none ## 维护者速读 - 用户能看到什么变化：在列表右侧预览抽屉里打开记录时，「详情」中的相关子表（如商机的产品明细）正常显示，不再报「组件渲染失败」；完整记录页不变。 - 为什么做：这是产品负责人报告的高优先级缺陷，在预览抽屉中打开带相关子表的记录的每个用户都会遇到。根因是抽屉的详情栏很窄，子表要决定显示几列；它测量时读到的是上一次的表格，于是在「1 列」和「2 列」之间来回切换，直到浏览器报无限更新。 - 出错会怎样：这次改动只影响这种窄栏子表测量列宽的时机；若有问题，最坏是窄栏里显示的列数不对，数据不受影响，可直接撤回本改动。 - 要你做什么：无 ## What changes **Root cause.** A related list drawn as a record's body table (the details section's master-detail table) leaves out the trailing columns that do not fit whole in its column, through the `bodyTableColumnCap` state in `RelatedList`. The layout effect that reads the cap lists the cap itself in its deps ("re-read once the table draws the columns that fit"), so every cap change re-reads synchronously, in the same commit chain. But `data-table` adopts a new `columns` prop one render later: it copies the prop into its own state in an effect. So the re-read measures the table still drawn for the previous cap. The columns already handed away carry no inline min-width there, so the read also falls back to their stale pre-draw estimates. At the preview drawer's default 460 px width, the details column is a 326 px scroll box. Measured in the browser on the CRM example (opportunity, line items with a lookup, a select, a percent and a text column added): - Cap 1 handed, six columns still drawn: the actions cell sits at its natural 66 px, so the read says 2 fit. - Cap 2 handed, one column still drawn: the table stretches and the actions cell is 118 px, so the read says 1 fits. That repeats every commit until React stops it with `Maximum update depth exceeded` (#185). data-table's own layout effects run first in each commit, so its error boundary takes the throw and reports `Component "data-table" failed to render`. The full page's details column fits every column, so the cap never moves there. **Fix** (`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx`, one guard in the body-table read). The read now refuses a table that still draws an earlier hand-over, meaning a different leading run of the list's own columns. It waits for the table to draw what it was handed, and the existing cells `MutationObserver` reads again on that re-draw. Every hand-over is a leading run of the list's columns, so the guard recognises exactly that lag. A drawn set that is not a leading run (a user's own reorder in the table) is still read. Edited files: `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx`, `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RelatedList.bodyTable-27055.test.tsx`, `.changeset/37212-drawer-body-table-column-cap.md`. `recordDrawerStack.tsx` and `data-table.tsx` are untouched. **Responsibility.** Whose code: the platform's own console code (the `@object-ui/plugin-detail` related list's body table, drawn by `@object-ui/components` `data-table` inside the `@object-ui/app-shell` record preview drawer). Existing platform path: none, since the full page draws the same table fine and the drawer path is the defect. Who reaches it: every user who opens a record with a related body table in the preview drawer at a width where the cap is between column counts (the default 460 px with the line items above). ## Tests A top-level `describe` in the existing body-table harness, `RelatedList.bodyTable-27055.test.tsx`: "RelatedList — a body table in the record preview drawer settles its columns (objectstack#37212)". It models the 326 px details column, where a table narrower than its box stretches and the actions cell takes its share. The real data-table is used, so its one-render column lag is the real one. The rows arrive from the data source, as in the drawer. - **Drawer case:** red on main (`failed to render` present, 54 cap reads flipping 1 and 2, the same pattern as the browser), green after. - **Full-page control** (a 1052 px box: every column drawn, none left out): green before and after.
Readings - Red on unfixed main (`35079023b0`): `× in the 326 px details column of the 460 px preview ...` with `AssertionError: expected

to be null` (the error boundary's text); the control passed. - Green on the fix: both body-table harness files, `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 40 passed (40)`. - Ablation (guard removed with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor 1 -> 0, blob `603b38b60982` -> `4adaa1c6dfae`): `Tests 1 failed | 33 passed (34)`. The one red is the drawer pin. Restored: blob after restore == blob at HEAD (`603b38b60982`), `git diff HEAD` empty. - `@object-ui/plugin-detail` whole package (`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/`): `Test Files 417 passed | 1 skipped (418)`, `Tests 3943 passed | 18 skipped (3961)`. - `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail type-check`: exit 0, after building its dependency closure (`--filter '@object-ui/plugin-detail^...' build`).
## Acceptance notes - **Browser** (Console from `ui/` source over Vite against my own CRM backend, line items as above), drawer width swept 380 to 800 px: - Before: React #185 and `failed to render` at 460 px only. The other widths settled. - After: every width draws the table (cap 1 at 380 to 500 px, more columns as it widens), with no console error. The full page draws all six columns. - The CRM example's stock line item (three columns) does not reproduce on main. The extra columns were a temporary local edit, reverted, not part of this PR. - **Release delta:** the report is against cloud 18.6.0. `RelatedList` at `@object-ui/*@18.6.0` (`958ee03594`) has no column cap. The cap and its re-read arrived after it (the "leading columns that fit" change, then #36379 omitted-column totals). This fix is against main; whether 18.6.0's own body-table read loops the same way was not measured. - **Bound:** if a user hides the last drawn column through the table's header menu, the drawn set is again a leading run, so the cap is not re-read until the list hands a different set. data-table also re-seeds its columns on the list's next re-render. - **Underlying property, left as is:** data-table adopts a new `columns` prop a render later (its re-seed runs in an effect). That property is documented in the read's own comment. Changing it would move every table's column timing, so it is out of scope here. ## Verification Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RelatedList.bodyTable-27055.test.tsx -t "settles its columns"` expects `2 passed`. Remove the `if (drawn.length !== handed ...) return;` line in `RelatedList.tsx` and the first case goes red with the error boundary's text. Read first, by risk: 1. `RelatedList.tsx`, the body-table read's new guard at the top of `read` (the only runtime change). 2. The new `describe` at the end of `RelatedList.bodyTable-27055.test.tsx` (the layout model). 3. `.changeset/37212-drawer-body-table-column-cap.md`. Security: none. --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code/session_01QSeKYmRepQK9DkZeU7F53D)_
